title: A bill to designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 90 McCamly Street South in Battle Creek, Michigan, as the "Sojourner Truth Post Office".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at 90 McCamly Street South in Battle Creek, Michigan, as the Sojourner Truth Post Office.

summary.headline: Congress named a Battle Creek, Michigan postal facility the Sojourner Truth Post Office.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 90 McCamly Street South in Battle Creek, Michigan, as the Sojourner Truth Post Office. It is a naming measure only. It does not change postal services, rules, or staffing.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on October 1, 2024.
